limitations: Source-visible surface depth is a learned monocular prior, not measured geometry.
No hidden backs, pocket interiors under occlusion, watertight volumes, material model, grasp or contact certification.
Independent source frames may change inferred depth and topology; no geometric interpolation is permitted.
The qualitative flexure/flap states are fallible Muse observations, distinct from numerical joint recovery.
Native SAM models and descriptive program remain intact and downloadable as originals.
Contour adaptation improves source-facing boundary sampling only; depth is a reproducible interpolation of an existing monocular prior, not independently measured 3D or repaired native geometry.
